Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates a dense opacity in the right upper lobe that respects the horizontal fissure without significant volume loss, a presentation characteristic of the pneumonic type of pulmonary adenocarcinoma (formerly bronchioloalveolar carcinoma), which can mimic lobar pneumonia but persists and lacks the acute infectious signs or rapid resolution typical of bacterial consolidation.
